name: Miro
description: Miro is a visual collaboration platform with an infinite multiplayer canvas where teams do research, planning, and product development from ideation through launch.
best_for: Positioned for product, design/UX, engineering, and product operations teams across industries who want to break down tool silos and align on shared direction.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Only 3 editable boards; older boards beyond that lock to view-only. 10 AI credits/month. No private boards, no visitor roles, no SSO.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: $10/member/month if billed monthly instead. Unlimited private boards, 25 AI credits/member/month. Annual invoicing requires a 10-seat minimum.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: $25/member/month if billed monthly. Includes SAML SSO but not SCIM provisioning or audit logs. 50 AI credits/member/month. Annual invoicing requires a 5-seat minimum.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales only. Adds SCIM provisioning, audit logs, domain control, and regional data residency.

cons: The Free plan hard-caps at 3 editable boards total — once a team hits that limit, no new board can be created until one is deleted or the team upgrades, and older boards beyond the 3 most recent become view-only.
AI features are metered by monthly credits at every tier including paid ones, with no rollover, so even paying customers can run out of AI usage before renewal.
SAML SSO is included on the Business plan, but SCIM auto-provisioning and audit logs are gated to Enterprise only, which itself requires a 30-member minimum and custom-quoted pricing.
features: AI workflows integrated with tools like Claude and NotebookLM
Multiple format support: docs, tables, slides, diagrams

alternatives.name: Lucidchart
alternatives.description: An intelligent diagramming platform for visualizing systems, processes, and organizational structures.
alternatives.best_for: Teams focused on structured diagramming over open-ended whiteboarding

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.description: A browser- and desktop-based design tool for interface design, prototyping, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need whiteboarding alongside actual UI design work
